service: Cardiac contractility modulation (CCM) for heart failure
vignette: 68-year-old man with ischemic cardiomyopathy, LVEF 32%, and NYHA class III symptoms. The heart team documents that he remains symptomatic despite 10 months of optimized guideline-directed medical therapy at maximally tolerated doses. The heart team documents that the patient meets the FDA market-authorized indications for use of the planned CCM system and has none of the contraindications listed in its FDA labeling. The patient is enrolled in a CMS-approved CED study of CCM.
rationale_note: Symptomatic NYHA III after 10 months of optimized GDMT per heart team; labeled indication; CED study.

service: Cardiac contractility modulation (CCM) for heart failure

The heart team documents that the patient meets the FDA market-authorized indications for use of the planned CCM system and has none of the contraindications listed in its FDA labeling. The patient is enrolled in a CMS-approved CED study of CCM.
rationale_note: Boundary: optimized GDMT for exactly 3 months, as determined by the heart team.

service: Cardiac contractility modulation (CCM) for heart failure
